records.claim_text: Cabinet Office guidance distinguishes an intention-to-contract award notice under the Procurement Act from a later contract-details notice for an entered contract, and explains that the award-notice label had a different function under previous legislation. The applicable regime, date and actual record are needed before interpreting decision milestones.
records.population: Procurement Act notice regime; not ordinary private payroll buying practice
records.time_period: Guidance inspected 29 October 2026; no employer time series
records.limitations: Interpret the applicable date/regime and actual notice. No transplant into earlier or differently governed cases, no universal private workflow or statutory timetable extracted.
